name: The Glitch Mob
description: '''The Glitch Mob''' is an American [[electronic music]] duo from [[Los Angeles]], California. It consists of [[edIT]] (Edward Ma) and Ooah (Josh Mayer). Boreta (Justin Boreta) was a member of the group from its formation until 2023. They have released four studio albums as well as a number of remix albums, [[Extended play|EP]]s, and singles.
